voice-author-notes-pollution.notes: P1 (status banner) fired on '> **Note on the screenshots.** The images above are *mockups*…'. Suppressing it would present mockups as real screenshots, which is a misrepresentation rather than a tidier page. AGENTS.md makes the same call in the other direction — '`## Not verified` is a real section and an honest one' — so an honest disclosure is the one status-shaped construction that must survive. The banner also tells the reader what to do about it (replace them under docs/assets/img/).
